key_insight: A Gemini-based agent autonomously discovered and formally verified compact, Collatz-like execution rules for eleven six-state Busy Beaver machines whose halting behavior remains unresolved.
engineering_relevance: The work illustrates how AI-generated conjectures can be paired with Lean verification to produce checked mathematical results in open-ended computational research.
method: Recognize patterns in Turing machine executions.
Conjecture compact acceleration rules summarizing many execution steps.
Combine informal mathematical reasoning with formal theorem proving in Lean.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports novel, formally verified accelerations for eleven BB(6) machines, provisionally classified as Cryptids pending community acceptance.
watch_item: Verified acceleration rules do not resolve these machines’ halting behavior or overcome the general uncomputability of Busy Beaver numbers.
paper_title: At the Limits of Computability: Steps Towards Autonomous AI Discovery on the Busy Beaver Frontier
